_doc: Reactions (gdd crafting v0.2 §16.2): the only way to get a qualitatively new substance. when: every entry must hold — a material id or tag (a|b = any of them) among the inputs' profile, no_air (a closed station), no_yeast, eff:<effect> (present), <property><op><value> on the blended item. at_heat: heat level needed. make: the material it makes; replace: the item becomes that material (otherwise its tags and effects join the profile). p: property transforms after (craft-expr, x = old). ratio: '<material> lo..hi' mass share of that material among the inputs. extract: extraction method it applies (all = every effect fully). risk_tainted: chance of the tainted flaw.
